invariants.rationale: The method calls file.extension(), so file cannot be null on any return path.
file.extension() is used and compared; it must not be null on any return path.
The method only returns a value if the extension is either 'tmx' or 'tmj'; otherwise, it throws.
Each code path returns the result of a getDependencies call, none of which are likely to return null.
If parameter is null at entry, it is replaced with a new Parameters instance before any use or return.
